notes.title: Animal Fight Club: Patch Update 2
notes.content:
[b]Here's some of  the changes:[/b]

[list]
[*]Improved controller input: Changes on controller's input and management has been performed.
[*]Improved UI Experience: Many changes to the way UI works has been made. Navigation through menus is now better.
[*]Fixed problems on Mix Machine menu with some Operative Systems.
[*]Improved general performance and net behaviours.
[*]Many minor bugs has been solved.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34703895/6614393d921e02ab46023ec8da93b93681d81298.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Animal Fight Club: Patch Update
notes.content:
The problem that dosn't allow some users to play has been fixed.

If you still have problems, please contact me at marco@corvostudio.it.

Other minor changes has been made.

If you have problems with the current build, you can play the legacy version, going to your library->right click on game->settings/properties->Last tab (BETA) and select "Legacy".

Marco

notes.title: Animal Fight Club: Australia Export update out!
notes.content:
[b]Australia Export update is here![/b]

Here's some of the news:

[list]
[*] 1 New map.
[*] 5 new animals.
[*] More then 300 new combinations.
[*] New in game camera movements.
[*] Mix machine and Order animal animations improved.
[*] Several bugs has been fixed.
[/list]

Marco

notes.title: Patch Update 23 April
notes.content:
This is just a patch update to [b]fix some stuff[/b] and add [b]Japanese language[/b].
Other things has been improved, and some sprites has been changed.
Performance now should be better on very low end devices.

Marco

notes.title: New major update incoming
notes.content:
While working to take Animal Fight Club on Nintendo Switch, we haven't stopped the development for PC.

In fact [b]5 New animals and a new map are incoming[/b].

The name of the update will [b]Australia Export[/b].

What animals and what map do you expect to find?

Marco.


[i]Oh, and we are also integrating Japanese language.[/i]

notes.title: New update
notes.content:
[b]Hi, and happy Easter![/b]

This morning I'm releasing a new update. This will include many many new fixes and stuff.
Some of the improvements are:

[list]
[*]Added randomized singleplayer battles.
[*]Added new ways to earn SPs.
[*]Increased SP earned from some missions.
[*]Improved anti cheat.
[*]Improved gamepad controls.
[/list]

And much more!

Have a great day,
Marco
